title: Geometry
description: The Geometry class provides the means to identify a Location as a point, line, polygon, etc. expressed using coordinates in some coordinate reference system.

gml.description: The geometry written in Geography Markup Language. Use "http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#gmlLiteral" as type for the literal.

wkt.description: The well-known text representation string describing the point, line or polygon. Use "http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#wktLiteral" as type for the literal.
